revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.3% and FY2023-25 revenue roughly flat; modest recovery fading toward GDP-plus growth. Analyst judgement, not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 16.5% (11151/67589) and FY2023-24 average of about 19.6%; kept near the latest level, allowing for some mix and tariff pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate 21%. Damodaran Machinery effective rate is 13.4%, so 21% is conservative.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 2821/67589 = 4.2%; FY2023 2.4%, FY2024 3.1%. Assumed 4.0% given elevated investment in capacity.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.01 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = Ke 9.4%. Beta: Damodaran Machinery cash-corrected unlevered 0.894 relevered at D/E 0.147 and 13.4% tax. Kd after-tax 3.97% (Damodaran Machinery). Weights 87%/13% (industry equity/debt weights, no CAT market cap available). Result is about 8.7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal US GDP growth of about 2-3%.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total_debt 43,330 (LT debt noncurrent 30,696 + current maturities 7,120 + short-term borrowings 5,514) - cash 9,980; no short-term investments reported. 10-K 0000018230-26-000008. Includes Cat Financial debt.
